title: The Last Golden Spire
core_task: After her husband leaves their nine-year-old daughter behind during a mall shooting, Evelyn, a landscape professional returning after two years away, leaves the marriage. To build a lasting home she must turn a job offer into dependable income, correct his unauthorized use of her professional name, own her mistakes at work, and let her daughter have a life beyond the betrayal.
core_conflict: Christian diverts money and attention to his former girlfriend and her child, then physically separates his own daughter from his coat and leaves with them during a mall emergency. Evelyn must spend finite resources to leave, correct a false professional-service promise and build a home without requiring her child to erase every good memory. A current sexual affair and biological paternity are unestablished.
emotional_promise: Recognition of accumulated betrayal, maternal agency, grief and an earned independent life.

principal_characters.name: Evelyn
principal_characters.occupation_and_status: Landscape professional returning after two years away; mother of Olivia.
principal_characters.lived_environment: Small furnished rental, work plans, crowded table and ordinary art supplies.
principal_characters.agency_signal: Packs and leaves with her daughter, then carries her own work.

principal_characters.name: Olivia
principal_characters.occupation_and_status: Nine-year-old schoolchild at the opening; ten by the final volume.
principal_characters.lived_environment: Model fragments, paper puppets, school support and a small new home.
principal_characters.agency_signal: Stops the shared model and later chooses her own collaborative work.

principal_characters.name: Christian Davis
principal_characters.occupation_and_status: Small landscape-firm owner, husband and father.
principal_characters.lived_environment: Family doorway and professional bid materials.
principal_characters.current_emotional_state: Urgency directed away from his own daughter.
principal_characters.agency_signal: Leaves his daughter while assisting Helena and Carter; later must carry consequences.

principal_characters.name: Helena
principal_characters.occupation_and_status: Christian’s former girlfriend and Carter’s mother.
principal_characters.lived_environment: Her own household and a costly equestrian bill.
principal_characters.agency_signal: Seeks continued support and later acknowledges its end.

principal_characters.name: Carter Hayes
principal_characters.occupation_and_status: Helena’s six-year-old son; not responsible for adult conduct.
principal_characters.lived_environment: With his mother, no independent financial or romantic role.
principal_characters.agency_signal: Accompanies the adult who receives help; no scheming or paternity revelation.

relationship_map.power_balance: Mother carries adult decisions; daughter has her own feelings.
relationship_map.visible_tension: Mother packs while child releases the last model spire.
relationship_map.shared_risk: Leaving familiar housing for a finite paid retreat.

relationship_map.visible_tension: A physical and emotional gap after a broken promise.
relationship_map.shared_risk: Trust cannot be restored by a pose or a payment.

relationship_map.relationship: former partners with continuing emotional and material expectations
relationship_map.power_balance: His selective help places costs on his own household.
relationship_map.visible_tension: His attention is directed toward her household while his daughter is excluded.
relationship_map.shared_risk: Do not assert a sexual affair or secret paternity.

environment_truths: Model is a relationship object, not magic.
Professional recovery requires ordinary work and paid care.

decisive_story_nodes.description: At the packed family doorway, Evelyn carries the adult decision to leave while Olivia lets go of the last gold spire.
Mother and daughter share a small home but pursue different creations: adult work plans and the child’s paper puppets.

secondary_signals.description: A small physical fragment from the ten-spire model.
secondary_signals.story_function: Accrued disappointment and the possibility of releasing an old expectation.

secondary_signals.description: A real landscape plan on an ordinary table.
secondary_signals.story_function: Seeded professional agency without glamorous rescue.

genre_emotion_profile.emotional_temperature: restrained anguish turning toward deliberate action
genre_emotion_profile.desired_viewer_feeling: Recognition and concern, followed by belief in the mother’s agency.
genre_emotion_profile.relationship_motion: Mother and daughter leave a broken promise while retaining separate interior lives.

commercial_visual_goal.first_glance_priority: Mother and daughter making a concrete departure
commercial_visual_goal.reader_identification: The adult who keeps covering another person’s absence finally changes what she will carry.
commercial_visual_goal.truthful_story_promise: A domestic betrayal novel with costly agency and lasting rebuilding.
